description: Creates an empty ruleset. Use ONLY when a human explicitly asks for one. A ruleset holds INSTRUCTIONS agents must follow — not facts. "Must use British English spelling" is a rule; "our spacing scale is 8px" is a fact and belongs in a context library instead. Prefer several small focused rulesets ("WordPress Standards", "Brand Voice") over one large one, because they attach independently to different workflows. Before proposing rulesets for a workspace, READ THE WORKSPACE FIRST: list its context libraries, workflows and agents, and read the workspace description. The structure is ground truth and does not go stale; the description supplies what structure cannot (who they build for, what regulates them). Never propose generic standards without looking. Cannot create the workspace baseline — only a person can designate that.

description.description: One line on what this covers and when to attach it.

name.description: Short and specific, e.g. "WordPress Development Standards".

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. If not provided, uses your default workspace.
